purpose: The Wishbone ZipTimer member of the real two-member OR group triggered alone must be uniquely attributed and its native pulse consumed through the verified declared-status read chain.
case_note: Same two-member group membership as joint-two-targets-ibex (identical members, ports, bases and trigger values), with the proven declared-irq-f5-wb-timer host pulse width of 16. Only COUNT(0x0)=8 is written, so the timer's o_int pulse is the single active member. mstatus.MIE stays enabled (no gate) like the declared-irq-f5-wb-timer case, and the observed member's declared status register is COUNT(0x0).
